headline: Rappler found that a viral 'handsome' grandson of Rodrigo Duterte is an AI-made character, not a real person.
score_reason: Fact-check of a fake persona; the article was unreadable and no other outlet carries it.
importance_line: Filipino social media users who shared the persona learn it was synthetic, a small case of AI fakes attaching themselves to political families, though the fact-check's evidence is not known here.
summary: Rappler reports in its Decoded fact-check series that a persona circulating online as a good-looking grandson of former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte was created with artificial intelligence and does not exist.
notes: Headline only: Rappler 403, no other outlet found. Score lowered 2 to 1 as unverified.
